description:
This process begins with identifying an employee's development needs or career aspirations.
The manager and HR create a personal development plan, which may include training programs, mentorship, or additional responsibilities.
The employee keeps working on skill enhancement while receiving feedback and evaluation from supervisors.
Once certain milestones are reached, the employee is considered for a promotion or new role.
HR conducts a formal review of performance, and if approved, the promotion is finalized with new responsibilities and compensation adjustments.
The process ends when the employee is promoted and transitions into the new role.

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/employee-development">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_EmployeeDevelopment" name="Employee Development and Promotion" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_ProcessBegins" name="Process begins"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_IdentifyDevelopmentNeeds" name="Identify employee development needs or career aspirations"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateDevelopmentPlan" name="Manager and HR create a personal development plan">
      <bpmn:documentation>The plan may include training programs, mentorship, or additional responsibilities.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_DevelopmentAndFeedbackSplit" name="Continue development and feedback"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnhanceSkills" name="Employee continues enhancing skills"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProvideFeedbackAndEvaluate" name="Supervisors provide feedback and evaluate"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_DevelopmentAndFeedbackJoin" name="Development and feedback activities complete"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MilestonesReached" name="Milestones reached?" default="Flow_MilestonesNotReached"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ConsiderPromotionOrNewRole" name="Consider employee for promotion or new role"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReviewPerformance" name="HR conducts a formal performance review"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PromotionApproval" name="Promotion approved?" default="Flow_ReviewConcluded"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_FinalizePromotion" name="Finalize promotion with new responsibilities and compensation adjustments"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TransitionToNewRole" name="Employee transitions into the new role"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Promoted" name="Employee promoted and transitioned into the new role"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ReviewConcluded" name="Review concluded"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartToIdentify" sourceRef="StartEvent_ProcessBegins" targetRef="Task_IdentifyDevelopmentNeeds"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IdentifyToPlan" sourceRef="Task_IdentifyDevelopmentNeeds" targetRef="Task_CreateDevelopmentPlan"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PlanToSplit" sourceRef="Task_CreateDevelopmentPlan" targetRef="Gateway_DevelopmentAndFeedbackSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitToSkills" sourceRef="Gateway_DevelopmentAndFeedbackSplit" targetRef="Task_EnhanceSkills"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitToFeedback" sourceRef="Gateway_DevelopmentAndFeedbackSplit" targetRef="Task_ProvideFeedbackAndEvaluate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SkillsToJoin" sourceRef="Task_EnhanceSkills" targetRef="Gateway_DevelopmentAndFeedbackJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FeedbackToJoin" sourceRef="Task_ProvideFeedbackAndEvaluate" targetRef="Gateway_DevelopmentAndFeedbackJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_JoinToMilestoneCheck" sourceRef="Gateway_DevelopmentAndFeedbackJoin" targetRef="Gateway_MilestonesReached"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MilestonesReached" name="Reached" sourceRef="Gateway_MilestonesReached" targetRef="Task_ConsiderPromotionOrNewRole">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">milestonesReached = true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MilestonesNotReached" name="Not yet reached" sourceRef="Gateway_MilestonesReached" targetRef="Gateway_DevelopmentAndFeedbackSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ConsiderationToReview" sourceRef="Task_ConsiderPromotionOrNewRole" targetRef="Task_ReviewPerformance"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReviewToApproval" sourceRef="Task_ReviewPerformance" targetRef="Gateway_PromotionApproval"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PromotionApproved" name="Approved" sourceRef="Gateway_PromotionApproval" targetRef="Task_FinalizePromotion">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">promotionApproved = true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReviewConcluded" sourceRef="Gateway_PromotionApproval" targetRef="EndEvent_ReviewConcluded"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FinalizeToTransition" sourceRef="Task_FinalizePromotion" targetRef="Task_TransitionToNewRole"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TransitionToPromotedEnd" sourceRef="Task_TransitionToNewRole" targetRef="EndEvent_Promoted"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
